# Resource nodes reference

The resource node component and the asset that sets its yield, tool and skill gates, respawn time and visuals. For how to use it, see [Resource nodes](../modules/resource-nodes.md).

## VtResourceNode

Component. Add it with **Add Component → Vantage → Resources → VtResourceNode**.

Resource node — tree, ore vein, fishing spot. Specialized harvest-feel behavior on top of the existing combat / item / skill systems.

### Inspector fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| Definition (`definition`) | [VtResourceNodeDefinition](#vtresourcenodedefinition) | None | Behavior config. Required — node silently no-ops if null. |

### Scripting API

| Member | Description |
|---|---|
| `bool IsDepleted { get; }` | True while the node is in the depleted state (chopped) and waiting for its respawn timer. |
| `float RespawnRemainingSeconds { get; }` | Seconds remaining on the respawn timer when `IsDepleted` is true. 0 when alive. |
| `event Action<VtUnit, VtResourceNodeFailureReason> OnHarvestFailed` | Fires when an incoming hit was refused. Args: (attacker, reason). Attacker may be null when the refusal happened before the killer was resolved (e.g. `VtResourceNodeFailureReason.Depleted`). Subscribe for "Need an axe!" floating text or audio. |
| `event Action<VtUnit, IReadOnlyList<VtLootDrop>> OnHarvested` | Fires after a successful harvest hit (the damage applied AND the entry roll produced at least one drop). Args: (attacker, drops). Drops have already been credited to the attacker's inventory and list only what fit, so a roll of 5 into room for 2 reports 2; the event is informational so consumers can render "+5 Wood" combat text or play harvest audio. |
| `event Action OnDepleted` | Fires when the node transitions to depleted (HP hit 0). |
| `event Action OnRespawned` | Fires when the node respawns (HP restored, visual swapped back, accepting hits again). |
| `bool CanBeAttackedOnCommand(VtFaction attacker)` | Every attacker may harvest the node on command while it is not depleted. |
| `void Initialize()` | Find the sibling unit and stats, listen to their damage events and spawn the visuals. Safe to call any number of times. |
| `void SetRandom(IVtRandom newRng)` | Replace the random source used for harvest rolls, for deterministic yields. Null restores Unity's random. |
| `void Tick(float deltaTime)` | Advance the respawn timer of a depleted node by `deltaTime` seconds and `Respawn` when it drains. Authority-only; other copies only count the timer down for UI. |
| `void Respawn()` | Force the node back to alive state — restores HP, swaps visuals, fires `OnRespawned`. Authority-gated. Idempotent (no-op when already alive). Public so admin / scripted-event flows can force respawn ahead of the timer. |
| `void ApplyDepletedFromNet(bool isDepleted, float respawnSeconds)` | Mirror the authority's depleted state: swap the visuals and raise `OnDepleted` or `OnRespawned` when it changes, and count `respawnSeconds` down for UI. HP arrives through pool replication. Used by replication on clients; refused on the authority. |

## VtResourceNodeDefinition

Asset. Create it with **Create → Vantage → Resources → Resource Node Definition**.

Authored resource-node behavior — the per-hit yield, tool / skill / damage-type gating, respawn cadence, and visual swap for trees, ore veins, fishing spots, and any other "harvest by damaging it" world entity.

### Inspector fields

#### General

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Id (`id`) | `string` | Empty |  | Stable string identifier for DB / network payloads. Convention: 'node.tree.oak', 'node.ore.iron'. Required. |
| Display Name (`displayName`) | `string` | Empty |  | UI display name. E.g. 'Oak Tree', 'Iron Vein', 'Berry Bush'. |
| Description (`description`) | `string` | Empty |  | Designer-facing description. |

#### Yield

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Harvest Entries (`harvestEntries`) | [VtLootDropEntry](loot.md#vtlootdropentry)[] | Empty |  | Weighted pool rolled on every successful hit. Each entry's (item, count) is added directly to the attacker's VtUnitInventory (no world-item spawn). Null-item entries are 'no drop' weight buckets, same shape as the loot system. Per-kill tables should use the standard VtLootDropper instead. |
| Rolls Per Hit (`rollsPerHit`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 1 | Number of independent picks against harvestEntries per hit. 1 = standard 'one item per chop' feel; > 1 lets boss-tier nodes drop bundles per swing. |

#### Tool Gate

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Required Item Tag (`requiredItemTag`) | [VtItemTagDefinition](items.md#vtitemtagdefinition) | None |  | Optional. When set, the attacker must have an item with this tag equipped in any slot. Pair with VtItemTagDefinition assets like 'Axe' / 'Pickaxe' / 'FishingRod'. Null = no tool gate. |

#### Skill Gate

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Required Skill (`requiredSkill`) | [VtCraftingSkillDefinition](crafting.md#vtcraftingskilldefinition) | None |  | Optional crafting skill the attacker is leveled in. Null = no skill gate (and no XP grant). |
| Required Skill Level (`requiredSkillLevel`) | `int` | 0 | ≥ 0 | Minimum level in requiredSkill to accept hits. 0 = any level passes. Ignored when requiredSkill is null. |
| Xp Grant Per Hit (`xpGrantPerHit`) | `int` | 1 | ≥ 0 | XP credited to requiredSkill per successful hit (NOT per kill — harvesters get steady XP through the chop). Ignored when requiredSkill is null. Set to 0 to skip the XP grant. |

#### Damage-Type Filter

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Accepted Damage Types (`acceptedDamageTypes`) | [VtDamageType](#vtdamagetype)[] | Empty |  | Damage types the node accepts. Empty = accepts every type. Non-empty = hits whose VtDamageType isn't in this list are cancelled before applying (e.g. ore takes Physical only — a Fire spell does nothing). |

#### Respawn

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Respawn Seconds (`respawnSeconds`) | `float` | 60 | ≥ 0 | Seconds after depletion before the node restores HP and becomes harvestable again. 0 = no respawn (one-shot node — killable like any normal unit, doesn't come back). |

#### Visuals (optional)

| Field | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Alive Visual (`aliveVisual`) | `GameObject` | None |  | Visual shown while the node is alive (tree mesh). Spawned as a child of the node GameObject at Initialize time, active until depletion. Null = no visual swap. |
| Depleted Visual (`depletedVisual`) | `GameObject` | None |  | Visual shown while the node is depleted (stump). Toggled active when the node is chopped, inactive on respawn. Null = node simply disappears visually until respawn (consumer can still rely on collision / interaction). |

## Enums

### VtResourceNodeFailureReason

Why a hit on a `VtResourceNode` was rejected (damage cancelled before it landed). Surfaced via `VtResourceNode.OnHarvestFailed` so the consumer's UI can render precise feedback like "Need an axe!" or "Mining 50 required."

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `None` | The hit was accepted — the node took damage and harvested. |
| `Depleted` | The node is currently depleted (already chopped) and is waiting for its respawn timer to elapse. |
| `WrongTool` | The attacker doesn't have an item with the required tool tag equipped (e.g. no axe in any equipment slot when chopping a tree). |
| `SkillTooLow` | The attacker's level in the required `VtCraftingSkillDefinition` is below the node's threshold. |
| `WrongDamageType` | The damage type (`VtDamageType`) isn't in the node's `VtResourceNodeDefinition.acceptedDamageTypes` list. E.g. ore takes Blunt only — a Slash sword bounces off. |
| `InventoryFull` | The attacker's inventory has no room for even one of anything the node yields, so the hit is refused and the node keeps its HP. |

### VtFaction

Team or allegiance of a `VtUnit`. Units of different factions fight each other unless either is Neutral; AI targeting, splash damage and projectiles all respect it.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Neutral` | Unaffiliated or ambient — not targeted, not hostile. |
| `Player` | The local player and their summons / pets. |
| `Enemy` | Scripted hostile units (waves, bosses). |
| `Wildlife` | Passive NPCs (deer, rabbits) — flee when attacked, don't aggro. |

### VtDamageType

The *element* of an attack — routed through the corresponding `resistX` stat on `VtCoreStats` in `VtUnitStats.TakeDamage`.

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `Physical` | Weapons, claws and falling rocks. Reduced by armor; resisted by stat.resist_physical. |
| `Fire` | Fire and burning. Resisted by stat.resist_fire. |
| `Cold` | Frost and ice. Resisted by stat.resist_cold. |
| `Poison` | Poison and venom, often dealt over time. Resisted by stat.resist_poison. |
| `True` | Bypasses all mitigation (resistance, armor, matrix). Use sparingly. |
| `Lightning` | Electricity / chain-lightning / EMP-flavor. Resisted by stat.resist_lightning. |
| `Holy` | Paladin / priest school. Strong vs undead in many genres. Resisted by stat.resist_holy. |
| `Shadow` | Warlock / necromancer school — corruption, agony, void. Resisted by stat.resist_shadow. Often paired oppositionally with Holy. |
| `Arcane` | Mage's "raw magic" school — distinct from elemental. Magic missile, polymorph. Resisted by stat.resist_arcane. Conventionally hardest to resist. |
| `Nature` | Druid / shaman school — earth, plant, weather, wildlife. Resisted by stat.resist_nature. |
